The '''Power Guard Cybernetics Lab''' was where the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] conducted the [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guard Project]]. It was located on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
